title: Triple expectation as an inner expectation
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function on the hypercube, write $x \oplus y$ for the componentwise XOR of $x, y \in \{0,1\}^n$, and let $\E$ denote expectation over a uniformly random point of $\{0,1\}^n$. Then
\[
  \E_x\!\left[\E_y\!\left[f(x)\,f(y)\,f(x \oplus y)\right]\right]
  \;=\;
  \E_x\!\left[f(x)\cdot\E_y\!\left[f(y)\,f(x \oplus y)\right]\right].
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function {0,1}^n -> R
